name: Csénye (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, pale blue and white in the ratio 2:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csénye: a blue and white shield with ears of grain, a patriarchal cross and a wavy stripe, between green branches.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
